lateral_coordinates: world-model convention: direction1 y,vy,ay unchanged; direction2 mirrored; sides in increasing canonical y
following_selection: gap 2–150 m; speed 5–60 m/s; own and leader |vy|<0.3 m/s; |ax|<8 m/s2; both non-abnormal
complete_lane_selection: contiguous raw track; 2–10 s adjacent change; peak |vy| 0.4–3 m/s; start/end within0.7 m of source/target centre; observed1 s pre/post history

label_protocol.choice: keep / lower-y adjacent change / higher-y adjacent change
label_protocol.onset: five directed vy>0.15 m/s frames and displacement>0.1 m
label_protocol.confirmation: first adjacent original laneId crossing after anchor, same canonical direction and same motion episode
label_protocol.non_crossing_episode: observed episode closure plus10 post frames is keep; a later unrelated crossing cannot confirm the cue
label_protocol.opposite_first_crossing: keep; later return cannot confirm original cue
label_protocol.censoring: unfinished/truncated episode, gap before evidence, nonadjacent or unmapped first transition, ambiguous onset
label_protocol.future_use: labels only; NPC inputs contain current state and observed history
